baseline_direct_play.subtitle: WebVTT or SRT
baseline_direct_play.streaming: HLS when native stream URL playback is not available

platforms.os_version: Android API 26+ baseline; current stable Android required for release smoke.
platforms.browser_webview_engine: Android System WebView/Chromium for embedded content only.
platforms.hls_support: Media3/ExoPlayer HLS playback, including adaptive variants and fMP4 when supported by device.
known_limitations: Codec APIs are not enough; update the Duskcue device profile from playback evidence.

platforms.os_version: Current Xcode-supported iOS baseline plus current physical iPhone release smoke.
platforms.hls_support: AVFoundation/AVPlayer HLS playback; Apple HLS authoring constraints apply.
known_limitations: Simulator does not prove decode, HDR, or audio route compatibility.

platforms.hls_support: Web playback follows Chromium/Media Source behavior; UWP future path uses platform media stack.
known_limitations: Hardware acceleration and codec availability vary by GPU, driver, and installed extensions.

platforms.hls_support: WebKit/AVFoundation HLS support for webview playback; future native path uses AVFoundation.
known_limitations: Intel and Apple silicon capability profiles must be kept separate.

platforms.os_version: Current Ubuntu LTS or equivalent baseline.
platforms.hls_support: Depends on packaged web engine and media libraries; Docker smoke must include fallback transcode path.
storage_constraints: Documented fallback required if keyring missing
known_limitations: Distro codec policy can remove codecs present on other platforms.

platforms.os_version: Current Android TV emulator plus current Google TV device firmware.
platforms.browser_webview_engine: Android WebView/Chromium for embedded content only.
platforms.hls_support: Media3/ExoPlayer HLS playback including adaptive and fMP4 variants when supported.
known_limitations: OEM TV firmware can differ from emulator and streaming dongle behavior.

platforms.os_version: Current Fire OS TV release plus one older supported device class.
platforms.browser_webview_engine: Android WebView/Chromium for embedded content only.
platforms.hls_support: Media3/ExoPlayer HLS playback unless platform phase selects another player.
known_limitations: Fire OS API and Appstore behavior diverge from Google TV.

platforms.os_version: Current Roku OS public release on a 4K player or Roku TV.
platforms.hls_support: Roku Video node HLS playback; Direct to Play and deep-link mediaType handling are certification inputs.
known_limitations: Model-generation capability variance is high; keep Roku model in the device profile.

platforms.os_version: Current Tizen TV emulator plus recent physical model-year firmware.
platforms.hls_support: AVPlay HLS playback; media specification and model-year checks are release inputs.
known_limitations: Emulator is not acceptable evidence for AVPlay codec/HDR/audio claims.

platforms.os_version: Current webOS emulator plus recent physical webOS TV firmware.
platforms.hls_support: HTML media HLS support according to webOS streaming protocol and model-year capabilities.
storage_constraints: Developer Mode expiry not release evidence
known_limitations: Pointer and D-pad behavior both need smoke coverage.

platforms.os_version: Current Xcode-supported tvOS simulator plus Apple TV 4K hardware.
platforms.browser_webview_engine: Not applicable for first-party tvOS app.
platforms.hls_support: AVKit/AVFoundation HLS playback; Apple HLS authoring constraints apply.
known_limitations: Simulator cannot prove HDR, Dolby Vision, HDMI audio, or Top Shelf launch behavior.

platforms.os_version: Current Windows SDK/UWP baseline plus current public Xbox OS on Series hardware.
platforms.browser_webview_engine: UWP WebView2 only if selected; media should use MediaPlayerElement/MediaPlayer.
platforms.hls_support: UWP media playback must validate HLS stream startup, seeking, and resume on target console.
storage_constraints: Credential storage API for auth material
known_limitations: Original Xbox One is reduced capability; Series S/X should be the release-required console target.
